title: Repair, Learn, Share · 原创阅读演示
subtitle: 两道原创阅读题，用于首次构建检查；不是真实考试材料。

sections.title: 阅读 A · Repair, Learn, Share

paragraphs.text: On Friday, the students at Willow School opened a repair corner in the library. Instead of throwing away broken items, they invited neighbours to bring them in. Mia, a retired engineer, showed students how to repair a loose chair leg. After the session, the chair was safe to use again.
paragraphs.translation: 周五，柳树学校的学生在图书馆设立了一个维修角。他们邀请邻居把坏物件带来，而不是直接扔掉。退休工程师米娅向学生示范怎样修理松动的椅子腿。活动结束后，这把椅子又能安全使用了。

paragraphs.text: The corner opens every Saturday morning. Visitors pay nothing, but they are encouraged to explain how an item was damaged. The club keeps a small notebook of repairs so that new members can learn from earlier mistakes.
paragraphs.translation: 维修角每周六上午开放。访客无需付费，但鼓励他们解释物件损坏的经过。社团保留一本小小的维修笔记，让新成员能从以前的错误中学习。

questions.stem: Why does the club keep a notebook of repairs?

options.A: To record how much visitors pay.
options.B: To help new members learn from past work.

questions.answer_source: 原创合成演示题与作者自拟答案，不属于真实考试。
questions.question_type: 细节理解 · 目的与同义转述
questions.type_note: 题干 why 问记录的目的，对应原文 so that 后的说明。
solve_steps: 定位题干 notebook，在第二段找到对应句。
识别 so that 引导的目的：新成员从之前的错误中学习。
把 learn from earlier mistakes 与 learn from past work 对照，选 B。
questions.analysis: 笔记本保存维修经验，目的是帮助新成员吸取过往教训。

evidence.quote: so that new members can learn from earlier mistakes

distractors.A: 访客不用付费，原文也未说记录收费。
distractors.C: 原文没有收集电话号码的信息。
distractors.D: 原文是修理椅子，没有出售椅子的安排。

questions.strategy: 遇到目的题，留意 so that、in order to 等线索，再检查选项是否保留原文的行动对象与目的。
questions.pitfall: 不要把看似常见的管理用途补进原文。

questions.stem: Which title best describes the passage?

options.C: A Repair Corner That Shares Skills
options.D: A School Replaces All Its Chairs

questions.answer_source: 原创合成演示题与作者自拟答案，不属于真实考试。
questions.question_type: 主旨理解 · 标题选择
questions.type_note: 标题要覆盖维修角的活动和经验分享，不能只截取一个细节。
solve_steps: 概括第一段：学生在图书馆办维修角，得到工程师示范。
概括第二段：免费参与，并记录经验帮助新成员。
选择同时覆盖维修活动与分享技能的标题 C。
questions.analysis: 两段分别介绍维修活动和经验传递，因此 C 能覆盖全文。

evidence.quote: opened a repair corner in the library
new members can learn from earlier mistakes

distractors.D: 修好一把椅子不等于学校更换所有椅子。

questions.strategy: 先用一句话概括每段，再选能覆盖全文主题和主要动作的标题。
questions.pitfall: 不要用一把椅子的细节代替全文主题。

structure.title: 活动与示范
structure.analysis: 先介绍地点与活动，再用修理椅子的例子说明怎样分享技能。

structure.title: 安排与传承
structure.analysis: 交代开放安排，以记录维修经验说明社团如何持续学习。

logic_steps.label: 替代做法
logic_steps.quote: Instead of throwing away broken items
logic_steps.explanation: 先写通常可能采取的做法，再引出维修和再利用。

logic_steps.label: 目的
logic_steps.quote: so that new members can learn from earlier mistakes
logic_steps.explanation: 解释保存维修笔记的目的，对应第 21 题。

inquiry.question: Why does the writer include the example of the chair?
inquiry.answer: The example makes the repair activity concrete and shows the result of sharing a practical skill.

quick_words.note: 此处修饰 chair leg，指椅子腿松动。

vocabulary.quote: showed students how to repair a loose chair leg
vocabulary.context: 这里说的是修好物件，让它重新可用。
vocabulary.collocations: repair a chair; repair a bicycle
vocabulary.distinguish: repair 强调使损坏的物件恢复功能；replace 强调用另一个替换。
vocabulary.teaching_prompt: What happens to the chair after the repair?
vocabulary.transfer: We repaired the old bench so that it could be used again.

sentences.quote: The club keeps a small notebook of repairs so that new members can learn from earlier mistakes.
sentences.chunks: 主句说明做法，so that 从句说明目的。
sentences.logic: 把记录与经验传递建立因果目的关系。
sentences.translation: 社团保留一本维修笔记，让新成员从以前的错误中学习。
sentences.teaching_prompt: Which part tells us the purpose of keeping the notebook?

writing_bank.quote: The club keeps a small notebook of repairs so that new members can learn from earlier mistakes.
writing_bank.why: 先写具体行动，再解释受益对象和目的，可用于介绍社团活动。
writing_bank.scene: 介绍新生互助或社团经验传递。
writing_bank.example: We keep a reading journal so that new members can learn from our discussions.
writing_bank.task: 换成自己参加的一项活动，写一句介绍做法与目的的句子。
writing_bank.check: 主句有具体行动，so that 后有清楚的受益对象与目的。
